# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment facts generated for the eShopOnWeb report. Use the links below to navigate directly to the supporting architecture, dependency, API, data, configuration, and workflow documentation.

- [Architecture Diagram](./architecture-diagram.md) — High-level application architecture and detailed component relationship diagrams.
- [Dependency Map](./dependency-map.md) — External dependency inventory grouped by functional category, including test dependencies.
- [API & Service Communication Contracts](./api-service-contracts.md) — Service catalog, endpoint inventory, DTO summary, and request-flow sequence diagram.
- [Data Architecture & Persistence Layer](./data-architecture.md) — Database configuration, entity model, repository methods, caching strategy, and data classification summary.
- [Configuration & Externalized Settings Inventory](./configuration-inventory.md) — Configuration sources, runtime profiles, secrets handling, and framework/runtime versions.
- [Core Business Workflows](./business-workflows.md) — Domain entities, primary business processes, and end-to-end workflow sequence.
